description: Chart Render. Render a previously saved chart by ID. Public, no API key required. Supports URL overrides for templates (?data1=, ?labels=, ?title=…).

data1.description: Override first dataset values. Comma-separated numbers. Use data2, data3… for additional datasets.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

format.description: Override output format. Allowed values: png, svg. Default: "png".

id.description: The chart ID returned in the X-Chart-Render-URL header when saving a chart. Format: cq-xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx.

name: chart_render
title: Chart Render
